help: 🏃 CoachBot · your running coach, 5K to marathon Get started /connect — connect COROS (required, do this first) /goal 2027-03-14 3:59 Hanoi Marathon — race date, goal time, name /goal 2026-12-20 half 1:45 — distance: 5k, 10k, half, marathon, 15k… /profile days=5 long=sun maxhr=188 born=1990 lang=en /plan — build a plan for you to approve Every day /today — today's session · /week — this week /daily — morning check · /report — weekly report /status — status · /sync — sync COROS (/sync full: 8 weeks) Feedback and safety /feedback <text> — how you feel (any message works too) /soreness 0-10 · /symptom — report pain or a symptom /pause · /resume — pause or resume your plan The AI coach may change a session at once (you can undo it) or ask for your approval first.
disclaimer: ℹ️ CoachBot gives training guidance, not medical advice. Stop and seek medical help for chest pain, fainting, unusual breathlessness or worsening pain.
start.configure_chat_id: 👋 This bot is not configured yet. Set Telegram__AllowedChatId={0} in .env, restart, then send /start again.
goal.usage: Usage: /goal YYYY-MM-DD [distance] [goal time] [race name] Distance: 5k, 10k, half, marathon (default) or e.g. 15k Time: H:MM[:SS], or MM:SS for short races Examples /goal 2027-03-14 3:59 Hanoi Marathon /goal 2026-12-20 half 1:45 VnExpress Half /goal 2026-11-29 5k 22:30
goal.invalid_date: ⚠️ The race date must be in the future and within 2 years.
goal.invalid_time: ⚠️ That goal time does not fit the distance. Use H:MM (e.g. 1:45 for a half) or MM:SS for short races (e.g. 22:30 for a 5K).
goal.invalid_distance: ⚠️ Supported distances are 3 km to the marathon (42.195 km).
queued.plan: ⏳ Building your plan from your recent training… This can take about ten minutes; I'll send it here. You can keep using the bot meanwhile.
busy.running: ⏳ Still working on your previous {0}. I'll reply when it's done.
plan.no_goal: 🎯 Set a race first: /goal YYYY-MM-DD [goal time] [name]
plan.infeasible_race_too_soon: ⚠️ The race is too soon to build a plan for. Pick a later race with /goal.
plan.verdict.realistic: ✅ The goal is realistic for your data
plan.verdict.unrealistic: ⚠️ The goal is not realistic for this race
plan.approved: ✅ Plan approved. I'll send your session each morning; /week shows this week.
plan.rejected: Plan discarded. Adjust /goal or /profile and run /plan again.
plan.not_pending: That plan is no longer waiting for approval.
plan.orphaned_on_coros: ⚠️ Remove these in COROS These workouts from your previous plan are already in your COROS calendar, and COROS tools cannot delete them. Please remove them in the COROS app:
workout.desc.rest: Rest day. Light walking or mobility is fine.
workout.desc.long: Steady and easy; practise fuelling and hydration.
workout.desc.tempo: 2 km warm-up, {0} km at tempo effort, 2 km cool-down.
workout.desc.interval: 2 km warm-up, {0} × 1 km hard with 2–3 min easy jog, then cool-down.
workout.desc.race_pace: Easy start, {0} km at goal race pace, easy finish.
workout.desc.race: Race day! Start conservatively and fuel early.
workout.rpe.easy: Effort 3–4/10, can talk in full sentences
readiness.none: No readiness check yet: it comes with the morning check (/daily) and after each run.
analysis.title: 🏃 Run · {0}
analysis.unplanned: Not in the plan; it still counts toward your load.
analysis.llm_concern: ⚠️ Something you mentioned may be a symptom worth checking. If anything feels wrong, use /symptom.
analysis.ask_rpe: How hard did that feel? 1 = very easy, 10 = maximal
analysis.failed_retrying: ⚠️ Couldn't analyse your {0} km run on {1} {2}. I'll try again at the next sync, or send /sync.
rec.auto_applied_hint: Tap Undo to keep the original session.
rec.expires_hint: If you don't answer within {0} h, the plan stays as it is.
rec.expired: ⌛ That proposal expired; the plan was left unchanged.
rec.expired_notice: ⌛ Proposal expired · the plan stays as it is
rec.no_longer_valid: That proposal no longer fits the current plan, so nothing was changed.
adapt.from_daily: Coach adjustments for the coming days
feedback.usage:
Tell me how you feel, for example:
/feedback legs heavy, slept badly
symptom.ask: 🩺 What's going on? Not medical advice: if in doubt, see a doctor.
symptom.button.cardiac: Chest pain / fainting / palpitations / unusual breathlessness
symptom.button.injury: Sharp or bone pain / swelling / limping
symptom.button.yes_current: Yes, I have it — pause my plan
safety.cardiac: 🚨 Stop training now. Chest pain, fainting, palpitations or unusual breathlessness need urgent medical assessment. If symptoms are happening now or are severe, call emergency services (115 in Vietnam).
safety.injury: 🛑 Stop running for now. Sharp or bone pain, swelling or limping can mean an injury such as a stress fracture. Please see a doctor or physiotherapist before running again.
safety.illness: 🤒 No training while you're ill, especially with fever or symptoms below the neck. Rest and recover; we'll restart gently.
safety.no_red_flag: Thanks for telling me. Nothing in that looks like a red flag. If anything worsens or feels wrong, stop and get it checked.
safety.plan_paused: ⏸ Your plan is paused and nothing more will be sent to COROS. When you're symptom-free (and cleared, if needed), use /resume.
safety.no_active_plan: You have no active plan, so there's nothing to pause.
safety.confirm_symptom: 🩺 You mentioned “{0}”. Just to be safe: are you experiencing this now or after recent runs?
resume.confirm_symptom_free: ▶️ Your plan was paused because of a symptom. Are you symptom-free, and cleared by a professional if you saw one?
resume.done: ▶️ Plan resumed. Start gently; I'll watch your recovery closely.
report.no_plan: 📋 No active plan yet. Use /goal and /plan.
report.pending_plan: 📋 The plan made on {0} is waiting for your approval: tap Approve plan on its proposal, or /plan to build a new one.
daily.title: ☀️ Good morning · {0}
daily.unconfirmed: ❓ No run synced for yesterday's session ({0}). Forgot the watch, or skipped? Just tell me.
daily.ask_rpe: How hard did your last run ({0} km) feel? 1 = very easy, 10 = maximal
weekly.title: 📊 Weekly report · {0}
weekly.volume: Volume {0} km · planned {1} km · last week {2} km
status.title: 📊 Status
sync.done: 🔄 Sync complete · {0} new activities · {1} days of health data
push.manual_action: ⚠️ Update these in COROS COROS tools can't delete or reschedule workouts. Please update them manually in the COROS app:
push.skipped.no_active_plan: ⌚ Nothing to send to COROS (no active plan).
push.skipped.plan_paused: ⌚ Plan is paused: nothing sent to COROS.
push.skipped.not_supported: ⌚ Your COROS connection doesn't offer workout scheduling, so workouts stay in Telegram only.
connect.browser: ⌚ Connect COROS 1. Open: {0} 2. Sign in to COROS and approve. 3. If the page you land on doesn't load (normal when the bot runs on a server), copy the full address from the browser and send it here.
connect.done: ✅ COROS connected · {0} tools · workout scheduling: {1} Loading the last 8 weeks…
connect.required: ⌚ Connect your COROS account first: /connect I coach from your COROS data, so the other commands work once it is connected.
connect.failed: ⚠️ That link didn't complete the COROS login (expired or already used). Try /connect again.
connect.disconnected: COROS disconnected; stored tokens removed. You can also revoke access in your COROS account settings.
alert.coros_reconnect: ⌚ Your COROS connection expired or was revoked. Use /connect to reconnect.
alert.sync_failing: ⚠️ COROS sync has failed {0} times in a row. Recovery decisions are on hold until data flows again (/status for details).
watch.title: ⌚ Watch metrics · {0}
llm.failed.plan: ⚠️ Couldn't build your plan {0}. Nothing was saved. Send /plan to try again.
llm.failed.report: ⚠️ Couldn't write the weekly report {0}. Send /report to try again.
llm.failed.daily: ⚠️ Couldn't run the morning check {0}. Send /daily to try again.
llm.failed.sync: ⚠️ Sync ran, but the run analysis failed {0}. Send /sync to try again.
llm.failed.note: ⚠️ Your message was saved, but I couldn't read it {0}. If you have a symptom, use /symptom.
llm.failed.symptom: ⚠️ I couldn't assess your symptom report {0}. If it could be serious, stop training and see a doctor. Use /symptom and pick the type to pause your plan.

llm.reason.http: The AI coach could not be reached
llm.reason.empty: The AI coach returned an empty answer
llm.reason.schema: The AI coach's answer could not be read
llm.reason.integrity: The AI coach's answer did not fit your data (wrong weeks, dates or workouts)

job.failed_no_retry: ⚠️ Scheduled {0} failed {1}. It runs again at its next scheduled time.
